comment.author: authecity
comment.body_excerpt: Hit the same thing in testing: behind a quick tunnel, every restart means a new hostname, and anything that stored the old one just goes q ... e line. This doesn't fix the underlying issue (the Console still wants a URL typed in by hand), but it makes it a URL you only type once.

reasons: Provides an on-topic workaround for tunnel hostname changes affecting webhook configuration.
